ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AND EASEMENT AGREEMENT (this “Agreement"), made as of the 30th day of November, 2010, by and between OAK POINT PROPERTY LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, having an address is One Oak Point Avenue, Bronx, New York 10474 ("Lot 180 Owner") and JMDH REAL ESTATE OF HUNTS POINT, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, having an address at 15-24 132nd Street, College Point, New York 11356 ("Lot 174 Owner"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Lot 180 Owner is the fee owner of certain land located in the Borough of the Bronx, City and State of New York, County of Bronx, known as Lot 180 in Block 2604 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of Bronx (the “Tax Map"), as more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Lot 180 Owner Land"); WHEREAS,Lot180Owner mayhereafterdesiretoconstruct ordeveloptheLot 180 Owner Land and construct a new building or buildings, in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement (any such building, or buildings, as same may be reconstructed, enlarged, redeveloped, collectively the “Lot 180 Owner Building") (the Lot 180 Owner Land, and the Lot 180 Owner Building, collectively, the “Lot 180 Owner Parcel"); Borough of the Bronx, City and State of New York, County of Bronx, known as Lot 174 in Block 2604 on the Tax Map, as more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Lot 174 Owner Land"); WHEREAS,Lot174 Owner mayhereafter desire to construct or develop the Lot 174 Owner Land and construct a new building or buildings, in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement (any such building, or buildings, as same may be reconstructed, enlarged, redeveloped, collectively the “Lot 174 Owner Building") (the Lot 174 Owner Land, and the Lot 174 Owner Building, collectively, the “Lot 174 Owner Parcel"); WHEREAS, Lot 180 Owner Land and Lot 174 Owner Land were previously encompassed within Lot 174 of the Tax Map (such earlier, larger lot, “Prior Lot 174"), which Prior Lot 174 constituted.a single zoning lot; WHEREAS, although the Prior Lot 174 was subsequently subdivided into current tax lots 174 and 180, constituting only the Lot 180 Owner Land and Lot 174 Owner Land, such lands, together, continue to constitute a single zoning lot; WHEREAS, the parties hereto are simultaneously herewith executing a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the “Declaration") in accordance with certain provisions set forth in a definition of the term “zoning lot” in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution in {NY112774;2}1
